scientific_integrity: The known existence and homogeneity of the Henson graph, the one-type subset-polynomial rule, and other previously recorded lower-arity enumerators are cited as background, not claimed as discoveries. The asserted contribution is the exact triple spectrum, arbitrary-fixed-arity leading bases, and conditional clustering phenomenon. Unindexed equivalent literature is possible.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns nonalgebraic ordered injective tuple types over induced disjoint unions of maximal cliques. Fixed integers r>=3 and k>=3; the asymptotic statements take the number of parameter cliques to infinity. Lower exponential bases beyond the three dominant ones are not classified. This is a mathematical proof with finite computational checks, not independently audited.
title: Exact triple-type spectrum and rare-edge clustering over disjoint maximal cliques in Henson graphs
